interventions.name: Bangun Commercial Teaching pitch 6 langkah (mundur dari step 6; grade SAFE-BOLD)
interventions.expected_evidence: 1 pitch lengkap (Warmer→Reframe→Drowning→Emotional→New Way→Solution); Reframe memicu 'never thought of it that way' di ≥2 dari 3 percakapan; skor BOLD ≥ median
interventions.contraindicated_until: Fase OFFER — offer sudah ada dan riset customer (TM-style) sudah cukup; jangan pakai pitch saat masih learning

interventions.name: Functional bias mapping + value planning sign-off (deal multi-stakeholder)
interventions.expected_evidence: Bias cards completed per role + value planning document with ≥1 stakeholder sign-off
interventions.contraindicated_until: Deal belum teridentifikasi multi-stakeholder (≥2 peran terlibat) — bias card untuk deal single-thread = buang waktu

interventions.name: Negotiation pre-call plan (power positions + concession scoring) pada deal bertekanan harga
interventions.expected_evidence: Template SSN terisi sebelum negosiasi; hasil: tidak ada cave-on-price ATAU trade sesuai rencana (low-cost-to-you, high-value-to-them dulu)
interventions.contraindicated_until: Deal belum masuk tahap negosiasi dengan value terbangun (SP-I02) — rencana negosiasi tanpa leverage value = latihan di atas kertas
